generatedProse.practice-connection: Across the School of Sport, working well with AI is becoming part of how you study and, later, how you practise. Every AI summary you weigh against the evidence, every session plan or report you shape rather than hand over, and every honest note about how you used a tool, draws on judgement your subject already prizes. Treat what follows as being about your own sport essays, plans and reading, not about AI in the abstract.
